description: Makes a new AI+ version of one shot for 1 AI+ credit, once approved: a VFX repeats its effect and options; natural motion repeats its prompt unless a new one is passed. version is the saved version to repeat (a number from list_ai_versions; default: the one playing now). The new version lands on the shot, undoable, and the old ones stay saved. A credit-using result's one free redo (Make again free) is the person's own button under the version after a thumbs down; it is not a tool. On a Full control connection it starts at once; otherwise it returns a confirmationId and waits for the owner's yes.

photoId.description: A photo: its photoId from the edit summary, or its play position like "shot 3".

prompt.description: A new prompt for natural motion; default repeats the old one.

version.description: The saved version to repeat: its number from list_ai_versions; default the one playing.

name: regenerate_ai_version
title: Regenerate AI+
